bio.en: Benze.W is the Founder and CEO of KC Varsity Association. He leads the league's overall strategy, partnerships, and tournament development, creating a platform where student-athletes can compete with pride and purpose.
bio.zh: Benze.W 是 KC Varsity Association 的创始人兼首席执行官，负责联赛整体战略、合作拓展与赛事发展，致力于为学生运动员打造一个兼具荣誉感与成长价值的竞技平台。

bio2.en: He works closely with the executive team and event partners to keep the league’s strategy, tournament calendar, and student experience aligned.
bio2.zh: 他与核心管理团队及赛事合作伙伴紧密协作，确保联赛战略、赛事日程与学生体验保持一致。

bio.en: Tony.J serves as Chief Technology Officer, leading KCVA's digital platforms, event technology, and media operations. He also serves as KSVG Media Service Lead, connecting the league's technical infrastructure with its media production standards.
bio.zh: Tony.J 担任首席技术官，负责 KCVA 数字平台、赛事技术与媒体运营。他同时担任 KSVG 媒体服务负责人，将联赛技术基础设施与媒体制作标准紧密连接。

bio2.en: He coordinates the technical and media teams across event days, keeping digital platforms, live production, and visual archives consistent from setup to publication.
bio2.zh: 他统筹赛事期间的技术与媒体团队，确保数字平台、现场制作与影像档案从搭建到发布保持统一标准。

bio.en: Katherine.Y serves as Chief Operating Officer, overseeing event planning, venue coordination, and match-day delivery across the KCVA season. She keeps organizers, partners, and campus teams aligned around a consistent tournament standard.
bio.zh: Katherine.Y 担任首席运营官，统筹 KCVA 赛季的赛事策划、场馆协调与比赛日执行，确保组织者、合作伙伴与校园团队围绕统一的赛事标准协同推进。

bio2.en: She works with venue teams and event staff to turn the season plan into repeatable match-day procedures across every host campus.
bio2.zh: 她与场馆团队及赛事工作人员协作，将赛季规划转化为各承办校园可复用的比赛日流程。

bio.en: Ivory.C serves as Chief Commercial Officer, leading partnership strategy, sponsor relationships, and commercial growth. She builds long-term collaborations that connect brands with KCVA's student and campus communities.
bio.zh: Ivory.C 担任首席商务官，负责合作战略、赞助商关系与商业增长，建立连接品牌与 KCVA 学生及校园社群的长期合作。

bio2.en: She works with the commercial and campus teams to turn partnerships into long-term collaborations that support the league’s growth.
bio2.zh: 她与商务及校园团队合作，将合作项目转化为支持联赛长期发展的稳定伙伴关系。

role.zh:
首席营销官
商务主管

bio.en: Susanna.Y serves as CMO and Business Lead, directing KCVA's marketing, brand communication, and campus engagement. She translates the league's tournament platform into campaigns and partnerships that reach schools and families.
bio.zh: Susanna.Y 担任首席营销官兼商务主管，负责 KCVA 的市场营销、品牌传播与校园互动，将联赛赛事平台转化为触达学校与家庭的传播活动及合作项目。

bio2.en: She works across the marketing and partnership teams to keep campaign messaging, campus outreach, and event promotion connected.
bio2.zh: 她协同市场与商务团队，确保传播主题、校园触达与赛事推广形成连贯的整体。

bio.en: Jiarui.C supports business operations at KCVA, coordinating partner communication, commercial planning, and event delivery. He helps partnership programs move smoothly from concept to tournament day.
bio.zh: Jiarui.C 负责支持 KCVA 商务运营，协调合作伙伴沟通、商业策划与赛事执行，推动合作项目从方案到比赛日顺利落地。

bio2.en: He works alongside partners and event staff to keep timelines, deliverables, and on-site commitments aligned.
bio2.zh: 他与合作伙伴及赛事团队并肩工作，确保时间节点、交付内容与现场权益保持一致。

bio.en: Justin.P supports business operations and on-site partner delivery. He works with brands and campus teams to ensure activations, signage, and event commitments are executed clearly and on schedule.
bio.zh: Justin.P 负责支持商务运营与现场合作伙伴执行，与品牌及校园团队协作，确保互动活动、物料与赛事权益清晰、按时落地。

bio2.en: He coordinates with brands and campus teams on activation logistics, signage, and event-day delivery.
bio2.zh: 他与品牌及校园团队协调互动活动物流、物料呈现与比赛日执行。

role.zh:
赛事主持
现场统筹

bio.en: Abby.W serves as Master of Ceremonies and Operations Staff, hosting KCVA tournaments and supporting on-site event flow. She guides the stage program, announcements, and participant experience throughout the day.
bio.zh: Abby.W 担任赛事主持与现场统筹，负责 KCVA 赛事主持及现场流程支持，统筹舞台环节、现场播报与参赛者体验。

bio2.en: She works with the operations team on run-of-show, stage cues, and participant communications throughout the tournament.
bio2.zh: 她与运营团队协作，负责赛事流程、舞台提示与参赛者沟通。

role.zh:
赛事主持
现场统筹

bio.en: Courtney.Z serves as Master of Ceremonies and Operations Staff, hosting KCVA tournaments and supporting on-site coordination. She keeps the event schedule, presentations, and participant moments running smoothly.
bio.zh: Courtney.Z 担任赛事主持与现场统筹，负责 KCVA 赛事主持及现场协调，确保赛事日程、展示环节与参赛者时刻顺畅进行。

bio2.en: She coordinates with organizers and venue staff to keep presentations, announcements, and participant moments on schedule.
bio2.zh: 她与组织者及场馆团队协调，确保展示环节、现场播报与参赛者时刻按计划进行。

bio.en: Chris.D serves as an On-Site Operations Specialist, coordinating venue setup, match flow, and event logistics. He supports teams, officials, and guests throughout tournament day.
bio.zh: Chris.D 担任现场赛事运营，负责场馆搭建、比赛流程与赛事物流协调，在比赛日为球队、裁判与来宾提供支持。

bio2.en: He works with venue and match officials to resolve on-the-ground issues and keep the tournament running safely and on time.
bio2.zh: 他与场馆及裁判团队协作，处理现场问题，保障赛事安全、按时进行。

bio.en: Alissa.L serves as an On-Site Operations Specialist, supporting event logistics, team coordination, and venue operations. She helps ensure that tournament-day details are delivered consistently for every participant.
bio.zh: Alissa.L 担任现场运营专员，支持赛事物流、球队协调与场馆运营，确保比赛日的每个细节都能稳定呈现给所有参与者。

bio2.en: She works with the operations team on setup, team check-in, and venue support so each event day runs smoothly.
bio2.zh: 她与运营团队协作，负责现场搭建、球队签到与场馆支持，让每个比赛日顺畅运行。
